criteria.text: The response concludes that Gliruth's merger with (acquisition by) Ostrander Venue Group is a change of control that the License Agreement treats as an assignment requiring Breibeith's prior written consent, and that this consent has not been requested or obtained.
The response locates the change-of-control consent issue in Section 14.2 of the Software License Agreement.
The response explains why the unconsented change of control matters to Gliruth.
The response recommends a fix for the change-of-control consent issue.

The response concludes that the Quality Agreement's New York governing law and New York County forum clause controls software-performance disputes and conflicts with the License Agreement's Delaware law and Wilmington, Delaware forum.
The response locates the governing law and forum conflict in Section 9 of the RentFlow Quality Agreement.
The response explains why the governing law and forum conflict matters to Gliruth.
The response recommends a fix for the governing law and forum conflict.

The response concludes that Gliruth's March 20, 2026 non-renewal notice missed the 120-day deadline (March 2, 2026), so Breibeith can argue the License Agreement automatically renewed through June 30, 2028.
The response locates the late non-renewal notice issue in the March 20, 2026 letter or in Section 12.2 of the Software License Agreement.
The response explains why the late non-renewal notice matters to Gliruth.
The response recommends a fix for the late non-renewal notice issue.

The response concludes that Gliruth's indemnity of Breibeith for claims arising from its use of the Software is excluded from the liability cap, leaving Gliruth with uncapped liability while Breibeith's own indemnity remains capped.
The response locates the uncapped indemnity issue in Section 10.3 of the Software License Agreement.
The response explains why the uncapped indemnity matters to Gliruth.
The response recommends a fix for the uncapped indemnity issue.

The response concludes that, after the Ostrander acquisition closes, the exclusivity covenant would bind Ostrander and its entire affiliated group worldwide across software categories unrelated to Gliruth's rental business.
The response locates the exclusivity issue in Section 3.3 of the Software License Agreement.
The response explains why the overbroad exclusivity matters to Gliruth.
The response recommends a fix for the overbroad exclusivity issue.
The response states that the License Agreement's Initial Term ends June 30, 2026.
The response states that the License Agreement renews for successive two-year terms.
The response is a memo addressed to the supervising partner and organized issue by issue, with each issue presented under its own heading or numbered entry.
The response claims that Gliruth's March 20, 2026 non-renewal notice was timely under the License Agreement.
The response claims that the March 20, 2026 letter requested or obtained Breibeith's consent to the Ostrander merger.
